note: General educational guidance. NOT reviewed by a dermatologist.

guidelines.title: Everyday skin care
points: Wash gently with lukewarm water and a mild cleanser.
Use sun protection on exposed skin.
Avoid harsh scrubs and strong chemicals on irritated skin.

guidelines.title: Caring for an irritated or unclear spot
points: Introduce only one new product at a time and patch-test it first.
Keep the area clean and dry; do not share towels or razors.
Note changes in size, colour, shape or pain, and take dated photos.

guidelines.title: When to see a doctor
points: The concern lasts more than a few weeks or keeps returning.
It is growing, bleeding, changing colour or shape, or painful.
You have fever, pus, or fast-spreading redness.
You are unsure what it is: ask a doctor rather than guess.
